edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner from msg.sender, making the untrusted caller the privileged owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
deployGLX is protected by onlyOwner, restricting supply initialization to the owner.
transferAnyERC20Token is protected by onlyOwner.
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender] with caller-controlled address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller address.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address.
msg.sender is used as a key into the balances mapping.
msg.sender is used as a key into the allowed mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] as part of its computation.
totalSupply performs a raw unchecked subtraction that may underflow if balances[address(0)] exceeds _totalSupply.
balanceOf returns the balances mapping entry.
transfer credits and debits the balances mapping.
transfer delegates addition to safeAdd.
transfer delegates subtraction to safeSub.
approve writes the allowed mapping without double-spend protection.
transferFrom moves balances between from and to.
transferFrom mutates the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom uses safeAdd when crediting the recipient.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance decrements.
allowance returns a value from the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external callback into the spender contract's receiveApproval.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
deployGLX sets the initial _totalSupply.
deployGLX credits the entire supply to a fixed address in balances.
deployGLX sets the deployed guard flag to prevent re-initialization.
transferOwnership stores the candidate address in newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership clears the newOwner slot after promotion.
